what_it_does: Extends the Houdini algorithm for automatically learning logical properties (invariants) that hold true during hardware execution, enabling formal verification of large hardware designs. Traditional invariant learning cannot scale to real designs because the space of possible properties grows exponentially. H-Houdini addresses this through decomposition strategies that break large designs into smaller pieces, learn properties for each piece independently, and propagate those properties through the design hierarchy, avoiding exhaustive state enumeration.
